metadata.description: Architecture for Swift server backends: gRPC microservices behind a Hummingbird gateway, typed-throws use cases in a Core target, adapters per technology, and executable composition roots.

plugins.name: swift-microservices-architect
plugins.description: Architects Swift server backends as gRPC microservices behind a Hummingbird gateway, one Swift package per service, with Postgres row-level security, Valkey and Temporal workflows. Use when planning a Swift backend or splitting it into services, adding a service, endpoint, use case, repository, migration, webhook, multi-tenant table, background job or durable Temporal workflow, drawing a Swift server's module boundaries or writing its Package.swift, wiring configuration, graceful shutdown, mTLS or JWT auth, naming server types and targets, setting up a server package's tests, CI/CD or deployment, or reviewing a Swift server's architecture or code style. Not for iOS, macOS or SwiftUI apps. Applies even when the user doesn't name the architecture.
